title: Feedback That Teaches
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: One question and one wrong answer, answered four ways, with each message rated against four criteria; only the last one passes all four.

educational.topic: What makes a feedback message teach
learningObjectives: The learner will rate a feedback message against four criteria and explain why only one of four messages for the same wrong answer is strong.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Does the message name the likely mix-up?
Does it point to what to do next?
commonMisconceptions: Telling the learner the right answer is enough
assessmentOpportunities: A message says "Incorrect. The answer is A." Is it strong?
What does "Good try!" fail to do?
What four things does a helpful message do?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
